Broaden to lakes, that Are mantled in green. And birds of all feather, Pure rapture inhaling, Sunwards are sailing, Sailing together, On to the isles, That lie smiling and dreaming, Where the bright billows Are rippling and gleaming; Where we see jocund bands Dance on before us, Over the meadow lands Shouting in chorus, All in the free air Every way rambling; Some up the mountains Climbing and scrambling; Some over lakes and seas Floating and swimming, Others upon the breeze Flying and skimming; All to the sources Of life pressing onward, Flushed by the forces, That carry them sunward; On to the measureless Spaces above them, On where the stars bless The spirits that love them.

@@U00390@@
Asleep! Well done, you dainty, airy lads! You've done your best and sung him to sleep. I’m in your debt for this concert. Youre not the man yet, 浮士德, to hold the Devil in his grasp.
translation:
@@U00388@@
扩大到湖泊，它们被绿色覆盖。各种羽毛的鸟儿，吸入纯净的狂喜，向阳航行，一起航行，到岛屿上，微笑着，做着梦，那里明亮的波涛荡漾着，闪闪发光；在那里我们看到欢快的乐队在我们面前跳舞，在草地上齐声喊叫，在自由的空气中到处闲逛；有的上山攀爬、攀爬；有的在湖海之上漂浮游动，有的在微风中飞翔掠过；一切都向生命之源前进，被力量冲刷，将它们带向太阳；到他们上方无边无际的空间，到星星祝福爱他们的灵魂的地方。

@@U00390@@
睡着了！干得好，你们这些可爱、活泼的小伙子！你已经尽力了，唱歌哄他入睡。这场音乐会我欠你的情。浮士德，你还不是那个能把魔鬼抓在手里的人。
